note: parse.ts's own docstring documents this exact historical bug: 'outbound call and email, explicitly no direct mail' once matched Direct Mail as a channel because a plain substring match can't tell 'use X' from 'no X'. The LLM path needs the same discipline the deterministic parser's isNegated() enforces - this fixture exists to catch a regression of the negation being dropped.
brief: Winback campaign for lapsed Xfinity Mobile customers in the Southeast. Outbound email and SMS only - explicitly no direct mail, and do not call the household phone. Launch 15 January.
